name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision amending Decision (EU) 2021/1764 on the Association of the Overseas Countries and Territories with the European Union including relations between the European Union on the one hand, and Greenland and the Kingdom of Denmark on the other
part_text: (7g) The Union and its Member States recognise and defend the right to self-determination of Greenland and of the other OCTs as guaranteed by international law. The Union and its Member States support the OCTs in making their own autonomous choices in that regard and support them in withstanding external interference, pressure, threats or attempts to change their status by the use of force of any kind.
